---
id: giant-panda
title: Giant panda
---
The giant panda (*Ailuropoda melanoleuca*) is a bear that eats almost
only bamboo, using an enlarged wrist bone as a false thumb. It occupies
montane forest in Sichuan and neighbouring provinces. Conservation
shifted it off the endangered list after reserves expanded, but habitat
strips remain fragmented. Cub rearing is slow; adults overlap little
except at mating.
